trivia_fact: Google Cloud Spanner is the only globally-distributed database that provides strong consistency using hardware-based time synchronization called TrueTime. TrueTime uses atomic clocks and GPS receivers in every data center to bound clock uncertainty to a few milliseconds.

Google Cloud Functions launched in 2016, nearly two years after AWS Lambda. Despite Google's engineering prowess, AWS's head start in serverless meant Lambda dominated mindshare. Cloud Functions initially only supported Node.js.
